svg.title: tropicalbee — Come in. Mind the spiders.
svg.desc: A block-built Halloween cottage in oak, cobblestone and forest green beneath a midnight-blue sky. The in-image Enter the House sign marks the game entrance. One bat moves slowly, a spider gently descends, a larger ghost blinks and floats, and pumpkin faces visibly flicker while their skins stay fixed. Link this entire image to the included Markdown adventure.
